resources.string: This app provides AI-supported health information and is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider.
AI-supported result — not a medical diagnosis.
We use selected health data and a machine learning model(XGBoost) trained on anonymized datasets to estimate risk. Results are supportive only and have limitations.
The app uses information such as age, blood pressure, cholesterol levels, symptoms, and other health indicators you provide.
Our machine learning model was trained on anonymized datasets to provide risk estimates. These are not medical diagnoses and should be used for informational purposes only.
Model 1(General User) accuracy: 97.8%\n Model 2(Healthcare Professional) accuracy: 89.93%

• Results are estimates based on available data
• Individual health conditions may vary
• Not a replacement for professional medical advice

This application is designed for informational and educational purposes only. It is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read or interpreted from this application.
